mapper.sql: d.def_id, d.alarm_cd, d.equip_class_id, c.class_cd, c.class_nm, d.alarm_nm, d.severity, d.symptom_id, f.fail_cd as symptom_cd, f.fail_nm as symptom_nm, d.auto_bm_yn, d.use_yn, d.remark, d.row_ver, d.updated_at, d.updated_by
from cms_alarm_def d left join mst_equip_class c on c.class_id = d.equip_class_id left join cms_fail_code f on f.fail_id = d.symptom_id

where.if: and (d.alarm_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or d.alarm_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\')

mapper.select:
select
order by d.alarm_cd, c.class_cd nulls first limit 1001

select
order by
c.class_cd desc nulls first d.alarm_nm desc d.severity desc d.auto_bm_yn desc d.use_yn desc d.alarm_cd desc ,
c.class_cd nulls first, d.def_id limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}
select def_id from cms_alarm_def where def_id = #{defId} for update

insert into cms_alarm_def (comp_cd, alarm_cd, equip_class_id, alarm_nm, severity, symptom_id, auto_bm_yn, use_yn, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{d.alarmCd}, #{d.equipClassId}, #{d.alarmNm}, #{d.severity}, #{d.symptomId}, #{d.autoBmYn}, #{d.useYn}, #{d.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning def_id
select fail_id from cms_fail_code where code_type = 'SYMPTOM' and fail_cd = #{symptomCd} and use_yn = 'Y'
select fail_id as id, fail_cd as code, fail_nm as name from cms_fail_code where code_type = 'SYMPTOM' and use_yn = 'Y' order by sort_no, fail_cd limit 500
select equip_id, equip_cd, plant_cd, class_id from mst_equip where equip_id = #{equipId}

select
where d.alarm_cd = #{alarmCd} and d.use_yn = 'Y' and (d.equip_class_id is null or d.equip_class_id = #{classId}) order by d.equip_class_id nulls last limit 1
select exists (select 1 from cms_alarm_log l join cms_mwo m on m.mwo_id = l.mwo_id where l.equip_id = #{equipId} and l.alarm_cd = #{alarmCd} and m.status in ('REQ', 'OPEN', 'WIP'))

insert into cms_alarm_log (comp_cd, equip_id, alarm_cd, alarm_text, raised_at, terminal_id, raise_event_id, mwo_id, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{equipId}, #{alarmCd}, #{alarmText}, #{raisedAt}, #{terminalId}, #{eventId}, #{mwoId}, #{by}) returning alarm_id
mapper.update: update cms_alarm_log set cleared_at = greatest(#{clearedAt}::timestamptz, raised_at), clear_adjusted_yn = case when #{clearedAt}::timestamptz < raised_at then 'Y' else 'N' end, clear_event_id = #{eventId}, cleared_recorded_at = now() where equip_id = #{equipId} and alarm_cd = #{alarmCd} and cleared_at is null
mapper.sql: left join lateral (select dd.alarm_nm, dd.severity from cms_alarm_def dd where dd.alarm_cd = l.alarm_cd and (dd.equip_class_id is null or dd.equip_class_id = e.class_id) order by dd.equip_class_id nulls last limit 1) d on true

l.alarm_id, l.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.plant_cd, l.alarm_cd, l.alarm_text, d.alarm_nm, d.severity, l.raised_at, l.cleared_at, l.clear_adjusted_yn, t.terminal_cd, l.mwo_id, m.mwo_no, m.status as mwo_status, (select count(*) from cms_alarm_log r where r.equip_id = l.equip_id and r.alarm_cd = l.alarm_cd and r.raised_at > l.raised_at - make_interval(hours => #{hours}) and (r.raised_at < l.raised_at or (r.raised_at = l.raised_at and r.alarm_id <= l.alarm_id))) as window_count

from cms_alarm_log l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id left join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id left join cms_mwo m on m.mwo_id = l.mwo_id
where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and l.raised_at >= #{from} and l.raised_at < #{to} and (e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\' or l.alarm_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or d.alarm_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\') and l.cleared_at is null

e.equip_cd desc l.alarm_cd desc coalesce(dc.alarm_nm, dn.alarm_nm) desc nulls last coalesce(dc.severity, dn.severity) desc nulls last l.cleared_at desc nulls last l.raised_at desc ,
l.alarm_id desc

e.equip_cd desc l.alarm_cd desc d.alarm_nm desc nulls last d.severity desc nulls last l.cleared_at desc nulls last l.raised_at desc ,
l.alarm_id desc
mapper.select:
select from cms_alarm_log l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id left join sys_terminal t on t.terminal_id = l.terminal_id left join cms_mwo m on m.mwo_id = l.mwo_id
where l.alarm_id in (select l.alarm_id from cms_alarm_log l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id left join cms_alarm_def dc on dc.alarm_cd = l.alarm_cd and dc.equip_class_id = e.class_id left join cms_alarm_def dn on dn.alarm_cd = l.alarm_cd and dn.equip_class_id is null where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and l.raised_at >= #{from} and l.raised_at < #{to} and (e.equip_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or e.equip_nm ilike #{keyword} escape '\' or l.alarm_cd like #{keyword} escape '\' or coalesce(dc.alarm_nm, dn.alarm_nm) ilike #{keyword} escape '\') and l.cleared_at is null order by limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}) order by

select l.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, l.alarm_cd, min(d.alarm_nm) as alarm_nm, min(d.severity) as severity, count(*) filter (where l.raised_at >= #{from}) as raise_count, coalesce(floor(sum(greatest(0, extract(epoch from least(coalesce(l.cleared_at, #{now}::timestamptz), #{to}::timestamptz) - greatest(l.raised_at, #{from}::timestamptz)))) / 60), 0)::bigint as active_minutes, count(*) filter (where l.cleared_at is null) as open_count from cms_alarm_log l join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = l.equip_id
where e.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and l.raised_at < #{to} and (l.cleared_at is null or l.cleared_at > #{from}) group by l.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, l.alarm_cd order by raise_count desc, active_minutes desc, e.equip_cd, l.alarm_cd limit #{limit}
